newsitem.title: CHINA: China wins $517 mln in foreign loans in first half.
newsitem.headline: China wins $517 mln in foreign loans in first half.

text.p: China attracted $517 million in contracted loans from 13 international financial organisations and governments in the first half, an official of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation said on Monday.
In the first six months of this year, China also signed $518 million worth of contracts for projects to be undertaken abroad and for exports of labour services, the ministry official said.
He declined to give any comparative figures for agreed loans or for the value of labour contracts.
By the end of June, the number of China's contracted workers abroad reached 288,000, up 32,000 from the same period of last year, he said.
China's actual foreign investment rose a year-on-year 5.35 percent in the first half to $20.721 billion, the ministry has said.
